name: dst810Enable
label: Connect to DST810 (BLE)
description: scan for and connect to an Airmar/B&G DST810 depth/speed/water-temp sensor over Bluetooth LE. No pairing needed - the sensor streams plain NMEA0183 once connected.

name: dst810Name
label: BLE name filter
description: only connect to a BLE device whose advertised name starts with this - the DST810 advertises as something like "DSTAF07CA". Only used until a specific sensor address has been learned below (see "Locked sensor address") - once locked, this filter is no longer consulted.

name: dst810Addr
label: Locked sensor address
description: the BLE address of the specific DST810 this gateway has connected to - filled in automatically the first time it connects (matched by name filter above), so that if multiple DST810-like sensors are ever in range (e.g. a neighboring boat's), it only ever reconnects to this same one instead of whichever answers first. Clear this field and Save to forget it and let it learn/bond with a different sensor again.

name: dst810SendDep
label: Send Water Depth (128267)
description: send NMEA2000 Water Depth from the DST810's $--DPT sentence. The sensor's own transducer offset (distance to waterline/keel, set up via Airmar's own configuration) is passed through as-is, not re-calibrated here.

name: dst810SendSpd
label: Send Boat Speed (128259)
description: send NMEA2000 Speed (water referenced) from the DST810's $--VHW sentence.

name: dst810SendTmp
label: Send Water Temperature (130316)
description: send NMEA2000 Temperature (sea/water) from the DST810's $--MTW sentence.
